## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.2

### 🎞️ Recording Playback
- Streams recordings through a private Home Assistant HLS proxy by default without keeping complete clips on disk.
- Handles camera HLS audio boundaries for reliable browser playback while preserving the recording's audio.
- Cleans up temporary playback data and proxy access when playback ends or the integration unloads.

### 💾 Optional Local Storage
- Adds a retained-recordings mode for users who want local copies.
- Adds storage location, retention age, size limit, background sync, and manual cleanup controls.
- Shows retained storage use and cleanup actions in the Recordings panel.

### 🌐 Interface and Documentation
- Updates the Recordings panel and integration options for the two storage modes.
- Updates the documentation in every supported language with the new playback and retention behavior.

### 🚨 Standalone Detectors
- Ensures standalone Wi-Fi smoke and CO detectors register their alarm, battery, signal, status, and other supported entities even when X-Sense returns them after Home Assistant finishes the initial platform setup.

Please test recording playback in the default on-demand mode, the optional retained-recordings controls if used, and standalone Wi-Fi detector entities.
